pass
php.version PHP 8.5.10 meets the minimum, PHP 8.5.
pass
php.allow_url_fopen allow_url_fopen is off, so the file functions open no URLs.
pass
laravel.version Laravel 13.4.0 is the major Cbox CMS follows, Laravel 13.
pass
postgres.reachable Connected to Postgres as cms_app@fake:5432/cms (connection fake).
pass
postgres.version Postgres 17.11 meets the minimum, Postgres 17.
pass
postgres.app_role The app role cms_app is not a superuser, has NOBYPASSRLS and NOCREATEROLE, and is
not a member of a superuser, a BYPASSRLS or CREATEROLE role, a role that owns relations or may create objects, or a pre
defined role that reaches every table or the server, signals other sessions or reads their query text.
pass
postgres.transaction_timeout transaction_timeout is 5000 ms on the app role cms_app.
pass
postgres.prepared_transactions max_prepared_transactions is 0, so no transaction can be left prepared.
pass
postgres.lc_messages Messages are English: lc_messages is C for the role cms_app and C for the role cm
s_owner, and LC_MESSAGES of the PHP process is C.
pass
postgres.ddl_privileges The app role cms_app owns nothing and cannot create objects in the database cms o
r its schemas.
pass
postgres.row_security All 2 tables with row level security in the database cms force it on their owner.
pass
valkey.reachable Valkey answered PING on fake:6379 (Redis connection default).
pass

pass

after Composer last changed vendor/ at 2026-01-01T10:00:00Z.

s.
